provider.name: local-procedural
provider.note: Reused the project's local procedural GLB workflow; no external generation service was needed.

assetOrigin: Original procedural mesh, embedded PBR maps, skeleton and animation; no third-party mesh or texture inputs.

artDirection.silhouette: Tall slim purple robe, dark purple sleeves, lilac cuffs, woven conical straw hat and floating red horseshoe magnet.
artDirection.face: Slicked dark hair, raised brow, side-eye and crooked smirk inspired by the existing character card.
artDirection.props: Right-hand opened folding fan and a separately bone-driven horseshoe magnet with pale pole shoes.
artDirection.motion: Two-bone IK arm targets, continuous three-bone limb skinning, coat follow-through, magnet spin and damage-attraction pulse.
artDirection.gameplay: The swing clip visualizes the insult gesture. The cast clip visualizes damage attraction. Damage transfer, insult count and elimination remain authoritative game rules.

standardization.coordinateNote: No horizontal Root.position motion in any clip; walk is in place. dead rotates Root for a grounded fall without horizontal travel.

rig.type: glTF SkinnedMesh skeleton with baked TRS animation tracks
rig.binding: FanPivot is a child of HandR and FanGrip is zero-offset from HandR. MagnetPivot is a child of Chest. Arms and legs use continuous three-bone skinning.

clips.name: idle
clips.semantic: breathing, fan sway and slow magnet rotation

clips.name: walk
clips.semantic: in-place walk with fan and coat follow-through

clips.name: swing
clips.semantic: insult: lean back, coil, left-hand point and recovery

clips.name: cast
clips.semantic: damage attraction: arms spread, magnet accelerates and expands

clips.name: flinch
clips.semantic: hit reaction with weight shift and fan guard

clips.name: dead
clips.semantic: grounded elimination with fan attached to the right hand

integration.renderer: sRGB output, ACES Filmic tone mapping, optional environment and shadows
integration.runtimeRegistration: Not performed; production CharacterRig integration remains a separate task.

limitations: Polished procedural stylization, not a photorealistic scan or externally generated character.
No external generation service or paid task was used.
The swing and cast clips are visual only; insult counting, damage attraction and elimination are not included.
Runtime registration, asynchronous production loading and CharacterRig integration are intentionally excluded.
